subject: [PATCH v9 17/32] mm: swap in PMD swap entries as whole THPs during swapoff

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch improves the swapoff process by allowing PMD swap entries to be handled as whole THPs (Transparent Huge Pages) instead of individual PTEs (Page Table Entries). This is achieved through a new function, `swap_pmd_cache_lookup`, which classifies the covered range as empty, one PMD-sized folio, or already split. The patch also introduces a new function, `unuse_pmd`, to map the first two cases back in as one THP, preserving soft-dirty, exclusive and UFFD state. If the cache is split, per-page zswap state, allocation failure, or poisoning occurs, the patch falls back to handling PTEs. The changes aim to optimize the swapoff process by reducing the number of faults required.
